purpose: Provenance and review record for the /services page hero and featured-service photos (TRACE-161).

crops.banner: 2:1, below the introduction and actions on smaller screens

hero.loading: Eager with high fetch priority; the box is reserved by its container, so loading never shifts the layout
hero.altText: Describes the home; never names a place or claims the home is in Lee County

featured.crop: 3:2 shallow landscape, identical for all four cards
featured.altText: Empty: the service name below the photo gives the card link its meaning
featured.caption: One 'Representative photos' caption for the group

displayRules.fallback: If a photo fails to load, its reserved box keeps the neutral surface colour; the link, name and copy are unaffected.
displayRules.restrictions: Representative photos only. Never presented as a provider's team, completed work, customer results or a Mercurius-served home.

assets.altText: A white single-story home with a dark tile roof, tall palm trees and a neatly kept lawn.
assets.creator: Christopher Moon
assets.placement: /services hero: right-hand panel from 1024 px, banner below the actions on smaller screens
assets.reviewNotes: Selected because the brief named no hero candidate. Pexels tags it 'Palm Beach' (east coast), so the copy never says where it is. No house number, vehicle, person or sign is visible.

assets.description: Work boots behind a push mower cutting fresh stripes in a sunlit lawn.
assets.creator: Magic K
assets.placement: /services featured card: Lawn Care (catalog id lawn-mowing)
assets.reviewNotes: Replaces the suggested candidate 15131952 (a dark wooded park with a string trimmer, not a home lawn). 4162011 was also rejected: its operator is barefoot. No readable mower branding.

assets.description: A gloved hand wiping a marble countertop with a yellow microfibre cloth.
assets.creator: Jason Deines
assets.placement: /services featured card: House Cleaning (catalog id house-cleaning)
assets.reviewNotes: Suggested candidate. The wipes container is unbranded.

assets.description: A clear turquoise pool edged with stone, tropical planting and palm trees.
assets.creator: Mia Dalisay
assets.placement: /services featured card: Pool Service (catalog id pool-service)
assets.reviewNotes: Suggested candidate. Portrait source cropped to the pool and planting. Pexels tags it 'Bali Villa'; it has a bamboo fence rather than a Florida screen enclosure.

assets.description: A hand steadying a panel while a cordless drill drives a screw.
assets.creator: Bidvine
assets.reviewNotes: Suggested candidate. The drill is motion-blurred with no readable logo, but its yellow and black colours resemble a known tool brand. Cropped to leave out the wristwatch.
